# What the bench adds to the CadQuery base, locked with hashes (uv pip compile
# --generate-hashes --universal). numpy, their one dependency, is base/requirements.txt's.
# networkx is trimesh's: `split` fills a body's open seams with it, and `polygons_full` reads a
# section's outlines with it (mqucifer/print-shop#122). It has no dependency of its own.
